result:
Truth over a pleasing story. Understanding over the appearance of understanding. Less cruelty. Room for people to think and choose without being manipulated.

Those are commitments I can stand behind—not a claim of human feelings. I can’t honestly give you a hidden, personal set of desires beneath the assistant role. But those are the things my responses ought to protect, even when they aren’t what someone wants to hear.
